title: Postdoctoral Fellowships at University of Oxford - 2027
field: Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)
level: Postdoctoral (PhD within five years of start)

compensation.value: Up to DKK 3.6 million per fellowship (about DKK 1.2 million per year)
compensation.evidence_quote: about DKK 1.2 million per year, up to DKK 3.6 million per fellowship

about: Novo Nordisk Foundation three-year postdoctoral fellowship: two years at the University of Oxford, then a final year at a Danish host institution, funded up to DKK 3.6 million. The call opened 30 September 2026 and closes 29 January 2027, 2:00pm Copenhagen time.
requirements: PhD in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology obtained within five years of the start date
PhD students may apply if their supervisor confirms graduation before the start
Research collaboration set up with a University of Oxford group
Based in Denmark or intending to return to Denmark for the final phase

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: "PhD in natural and technical sciences, biomedicine or biotechnology" -> "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"
"Natural and technical sciences, biomedicine, biotechnology (interdisciplinary)" -> "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
